promptTemplate: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original decorative industry illustration for the upper-right corner of a desktop app category card. Create ONE isolated sculptural still-life illustration of: {scene}. Palette: {palette}. Style: sophisticated tactile paper-clay hybrid, softly bevelled geometric forms, matte surfaces, a few translucent accents, soft studio shading, restrained modern editorial illustration. Design a fresh original object arrangement. Composition: a compact diagonal grouping centered in the square frame, comfortably contained within the central 78%, clear recognizable silhouette at 96px, very few objects, lots of transparent breathing room around the grouping. True transparent background with clean alpha, soft self-shadows only, no floor, no colored backdrop, no rectangular or circular backing. No people, faces, mascots, text, letters, numbers, brand marks, logos, watermark, trophy, flame, sprout, medal or ranking badge. This is a decorative image asset, not a UI screenshot. Use a square canvas.
